youtube.title: Erik the Red called it Greenland to scam the Vikings 🧊 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Erik the Red named an icy island "Greenland"… on purpose. The first real estate ad in history. 🧊

Would YOU have sailed there? Yes or no 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: around 985 AD Erik the Red led Viking settlers from Iceland to a huge, mostly ice-covered island. The Saga of Erik the Red says he called it Greenland because people would be more eager to go there if the land had a good name.
